filing_office: Vermont Secretary of State, Business Services Division
filing_fee_notes: Domestic LLC formation fee; the formation guide lists no additional fee for online filing.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a registered agent with a Vermont registered office and mailing address. The agent may be a qualifying individual or active registered business other than the LLC itself.
standard_processing_time: Online: less than one business day. Mail: 7–10 business days.
annual_report_due: Within three months after the fiscal year-end recorded with the Secretary of State.
plain_english_summary: Domestic LLC formation costs 155 and the annual report costs 45. The report deadline follows the recorded fiscal year-end.
common_mistake: Using the wrong fiscal year-end can lead to a missed report deadline.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Filing URLs are official gateways. Name-search URL, expedited service, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
